alt_version._what_is: How a site is recognised as already having the version you would sell (here: a Spanish version). If the site has it, offers that need it absent (localization) are not made.

quality._what_is: Company-specific parts of the first-line quality check. The universal rules (needs 2 words only that site uses, repeated ending, fill-in-the-blank template) are in code.
quality.unsupported_claim_hint: Say it as a general market fact ("in this region a lot of kitchens work in Spanish"), not as a claim about their clients or staff.

offer_ladder._what_is: One offer per email. 'partner_offers' = sector offers that always win (partners refer clients, they are not buyers). 'rules' are tried top to bottom, the first match wins; 'sector' means the offer of the company's own sector (the fallback). 'when' accepts: sectors, signals_any, signals_all, signals_none, missing_alt_version, site_dated. 'alternates' define extra offers (subject, paragraph, optional signature link) that a rule can pick.

subject.en: a Spanish version of your website
subject.es: la versión en español de su web

block.en: I translate websites into Spanish: every page, the menus, the forms and the titles and descriptions Google reads, so people searching in Spanish find you. I deliver in whatever format is easiest for you, with no change of platform, and each project keeps a glossary so the same term reads the same across the whole site.
block.es: Traduzco webs al español: cada página, los menús, los formularios y los títulos y descripciones que lee Google, para que quien busca en español los encuentre. Entrego en el formato que les resulte más fácil, sin cambiar de plataforma, y cada proyecto lleva un glosario para que el mismo término diga lo mismo en todo el sitio.

subject.en: your website in English and Spanish
subject.es: su web en español y en inglés

block.en: I build new websites in English and Spanish from the start: fast, made for phones, and with the titles and descriptions Google reads in both languages, so people searching in Spanish find you.
block.es: Hago webs nuevas en inglés y en español desde el principio: rápidas, pensadas para el celular y con los títulos y descripciones que lee Google en los dos idiomas, para que quien busca en español los encuentre.
